data.one_liner: Cryptographic algorithms for encryption, signatures, key agreement, and hashing across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides popular cryptographic algorithms including AES, ChaCha20, ED25519, X25519, Argon2, and various hashing and MAC functions. It supports multi-platform usage with optimized browser Web Crypto and operating system APIs.
use_when: You need secure encryption, decryption, or password hashing in your Dart or Flutter application.
You require cross-platform cryptographic operations with browser performance optimization.
avoid_when: You only need simple built-in Dart operations without advanced ciphers or key exchange protocols.
strengths: Good cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop.
Utilizes platform APIs and Web Cryptography for improved performance.
Comprehensive algorithm support (AES, ChaCha20, Ed25519, Argon2id, etc.).
weaknesses: Some non-Dart algorithms (like NIST elliptic curves and RSA) lack pure-Dart implementations.
Complex API surface with ongoing transitions to wands and new major versions.
data.setup_notes: Optionally import cryptography_flutter_plus when using Flutter to delegate calls to Android/iOS/macOS OS APIs.

alternatives.name: cryptography
alternatives.why_pick_it: The original package maintained by gohilla before repository movement and community updates in cryptography_plus.
